overloads.semanticRole: The SET ASSERT ENABLED command can be used to disable or re-enable any assertions inserted into the 4D code of the application.

constraints: By default, assertions are enabled in both interpreted and compiled mode.
By default this command affects all processes of the application (existing or created subsequently); pass the optional * parameter to restrict the effect to the current process only.
When assertions are disabled, expressions passed to ASSERT commands are no longer evaluated at all -- the calling lines have no effect on behavior or performance.
